products.productCare: To maintain the value and appearance of your goods, please observe the following guidelines: - Avoid contact with water, oily substances, perfumes, make-up and other liquid, alcoholic or fatty substances. - Avoid using generic cleaning products such as shoe polish, trichlorethylene, oils, stain removers, alcohol and solvents. - Avoid contact with rough or abrasive surfaces. - Avoid allowing light-coloured products to come into contact with dark or brightly coloured clothing and vice versa. Colours may transfer from one object to another. - Light-coloured bags, especially white and beige bags, are particularly sensitive to light, dust and stains. - Avoid prolonged exposure to light, direct heat and humidity. Materials may be damaged, and their appearance altered. - In case of contact with water, gently pat the area to absorb moisture with a soft, neutral coloured cloth. Avoid excessive rubbing. - Store the product upright in its protective flannel bag. We recommend padding your bag with tissue paper to maintain its shape.
